nodes.label: CodeHive primary logo mark
nodes.description: A centered hexagonal badge with a thick dark-navy outline and warm yellow fill. Inside, a dark-navy code symbol is formed by left and right angle brackets separated by a tall diagonal slash.

nodes.label: Programming identity
nodes.description: The angle brackets and slash visually identify the product with source code and software development.

nodes.label: Hive-inspired badge rationale
nodes.description: The hexagon and yellow-and-navy palette evoke a honeycomb or hive while the enclosed, high-contrast mark keeps the coding theme legible at a glance.
